name: GitHub
description: Read and manage repos, issues, and PRs through GitHub's official hosted MCP server.
summary: Read and manage repos, issues, and PRs through GitHub's hosted MCP server.
note: Nothing to install locally. On first use a browser opens to sign in to GitHub; no token to manage.
package: GitHub-hosted remote MCP server (no local install)
dataNote: Connects to GitHub's hosted MCP server with your GitHub account; the model can read and manage the repos, issues, and PRs you grant.

name: Filesystem
description: Gives Claude scoped read/write access to a local directory.
summary: Gives Claude scoped read/write access to a local directory.
note: Edit the path arg in .mcp.json to the directory you want to expose.
dataNote: Runs locally with no network calls, but exposes the configured directory's files to the AI model.

name: Playwright
description: Drives a real browser for UI QA, screenshots, and accessibility checks.
summary: Drives a real browser for UI QA, screenshots, and accessibility checks.
dataNote: Downloads browser binaries on first run and visits the URLs you or the model open.

name: Context7
description: Pulls up-to-date, version-specific docs for libraries and frameworks.
summary: Pulls up-to-date, version-specific docs for libraries and frameworks.
package: Context7 hosted remote MCP server (no local install); local fallback: @upstash/context7-mcp via npx
dataNote: Sends the library names and queries you look up to Context7's hosted service.
note: Uses Context7's hosted endpoint. An API key is optional; if you add one, set it from an environment variable in your own .mcp.json and never commit it.

name: Sequential Thinking
description: A step-by-step reasoning scratchpad for hard problems.
summary: A step-by-step reasoning scratchpad for hard problems.
dataNote: Runs locally with no external calls.

name: Roblox Studio
description: Connects an AI client to a live Roblox Studio session to explore and script it.
summary: Connects an AI client to a live Roblox Studio session.
note: Uses Roblox's built-in Studio MCP server. In Studio, open Assistant > Manage MCP Servers, turn on "Enable Studio as MCP server", then restart Studio. Install is skipped on Linux.
package: Roblox Studio's built-in MCP server (no separate install)
dataNote: Bridges an AI client to your local Studio session; the AI can read your place's data model and write and run Luau code in it.

name: Unity AI Assistant MCP (Official · Unity 6+)
description: Unity's official editor MCP bridge, provided by the Unity AI Assistant package.
summary: Unity's official editor MCP bridge (Unity 6000.0+).
note: Needs Unity 6 (6000.0) or later with the com.unity.ai.assistant package. In Unity, open Edit > Project Settings > AI > Unity MCP Server, confirm it shows Running, and accept the first connection.
package: Unity AI Assistant package com.unity.ai.assistant (relay binary installed under ~/.unity/relay/)
dataNote: Local relay to your open Unity Editor; the AI can read and modify the open project's scenes and assets. Unity asks you to approve each new client.

name: UEFN Bridge (Trashbyrd's Power Tools)
description: Live UEFN editor control from Claude through Trashbyrd's Power Tools.
summary: Live UEFN editor control through Trashbyrd's Power Tools.
note: Provided by Trashbyrd's Power Tools, which TycoonAgents never installs or modifies. Install Power Tools first (see its INSTALL.md), then click Enable MCP here and confirm the command shown.
package: Trashbyrd's Power Tools (downloaded release, run via `node`; not published to npm)
dataNote: Runs locally and talks to your open UEFN session through temp files; no network calls.

name: Unreal Engine MCP (Official · UE 5.8+)
description: Epic's official in-editor MCP server for Unreal Editor 5.8+.
summary: Epic's official in-editor MCP server for Unreal Editor 5.8+.
note: Built into the editor. Enable the "Unreal MCP" and "All Toolsets" plugins, then turn on Auto Start Server in Editor Preferences. For Unreal Engine projects; UEFN uses the UEFN Bridge.
dataNote: Local connection to your own running Unreal Editor; nothing leaves your machine.

name: Blender
description: Live Blender scene control through the official Blender Lab MCP server (Blender 5.1+).
summary: Live Blender scene control through the official Blender Lab MCP server.
note: Needs Blender 5.1 or newer with the official MCP add-on enabled and its server started (port 9876), plus the uv package manager. The MCP server executes LLM-generated code in Blender without any guards, so back up your .blend and avoid sensitive data. If you used the community 'MCP for Blender' add-on, disable it first (same port).
dataNote: Runs locally and talks to the Blender add-on on localhost:9876. First launch downloads the server and its Python dependencies. The server runs AI-generated code in Blender without guards.

name: Codex (OpenAI)
description: Runs OpenAI's Codex with your ChatGPT sign-in.
summary: Runs OpenAI's Codex with your ChatGPT sign-in.
note: Set up from the Agents screen. Needs the Codex CLI signed in with `codex login`.
dataNote: Prompts, code, and file contents you send through this server are sent to OpenAI under your ChatGPT account. OpenAI is a different vendor than Anthropic.

name: Claude CLI
description: Runs Claude through your own Claude CLI sign-in.
summary: Runs Claude through your own Claude CLI sign-in.
note: Set up from the Agents screen. Uses the Claude CLI you already signed in to; TycoonAgents never sees or stores credentials. Runs read-only in plan mode by default.
package: hooks/claude-cli-mcp.cjs (bundled with TycoonAgents; requires the `claude` CLI already installed and logged in)
dataNote: Prompts sent through this server go to Anthropic under your own Claude account, the same as using Claude Code directly.

name: TycoonAgents Dispatcher
description: Runs an agent's provider fallback chain in a single tool call.
summary: Runs an agent's provider fallback chain in one call.
note: Set up from the Agents screen. It uses the other bridge servers configured in this project, so those must stay configured.
package: hooks/tycoon-dispatcher-mcp.cjs (bundled with TycoonAgents; copied into .claude/hooks/ on hook install)
dataNote: Runs locally and only forwards tasks to the bridge servers already configured in this project; it adds no network destination of its own.

name: Dart & Flutter
description: Analyzes and fixes Dart and Flutter code through Google's official dart mcp-server.
summary: Analyzes and fixes Dart and Flutter code through Google's dart mcp-server.
note: Provided by the Dart SDK (3.9+) on your PATH, so there is nothing separate to install. Best used inside a Flutter or Dart project.
package: dart mcp-server (bundled with the Dart SDK 3.9+; run via `dart`)
dataNote: Runs locally on your project's Dart source; contacts pub.dev when searching packages or fetching docs.

name: Gemini (Google)
description: Runs Google's Gemini models.
summary: Runs Google's Gemini models.
note: Set up from the Agents screen. Uses a community MCP bridge (jamubc/gemini-mcp-tool) over a local Gemini-capable CLI that you sign in to yourself. The first run downloads the pinned bridge package from npm.
package: gemini-mcp-tool (community bridge over Google's gemini CLI, pinned 1.1.8, run via `npx` through the bundled wrapper)
dataNote: Prompts and content you send through this server leave this machine and go to Google's Gemini backend under your own sign-in. It runs through a community bridge, not an official Google MCP server.

name: OpenAI-Compatible Endpoint
description: Calls any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint.
summary: Calls any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint.
note: Set up from the Agents screen. Point it at a local or hosted server that exposes /v1/chat/completions; an API key is optional for local servers.
package: hooks/openai-compatible-mcp.cjs (bundled with this project, run via `node`)
dataNote: Prompts go to whatever host you point it at. A local server never leaves your machine; a hosted endpoint sends data to that vendor under your own key.

name: Supabase (Official)
description: Manage Supabase projects from Claude through Supabase's official hosted MCP server.
summary: Manage Supabase projects through Supabase's hosted MCP server.
note: Nothing to install locally. Sign in with OAuth in the browser on first use. Prefer read_only=true and a non-production project.
package: Supabase-hosted remote MCP server (no local install)
dataNote: Connects to Supabase's hosted MCP server with your Supabase account; the model can read and change the projects and databases you grant.

name: Sentry (Official)
description: Search errors and manage issues through Sentry's official hosted MCP server.
summary: Search errors and manage issues through Sentry's hosted MCP server.
note: Nothing to install locally. The first connection opens a browser to sign in to Sentry.
package: Sentry-hosted remote MCP server (no local install)
dataNote: Connects to Sentry's hosted MCP server with your Sentry account; the model can read and manage the organizations and projects you grant.

name: Stripe (Official)
description: Use the Stripe API and search Stripe's docs through Stripe's official hosted MCP server.
summary: Use the Stripe API and docs through Stripe's hosted MCP server.
note: Nothing to install locally. Run /mcp in Claude Code and authenticate Stripe. Use a sandbox while testing; Stripe asks for confirmation before sensitive writes.
package: Stripe-hosted remote MCP server (no local install)
dataNote: Connects to Stripe's hosted MCP server with your Stripe account; the model can read and, with confirmation, change payments, customers, and billing data.

name: Figma (Official)
description: Bring Figma design context into Claude through Figma's official hosted MCP server.
summary: Bring Figma design context into Claude through Figma's hosted MCP server.
note: Nothing to install locally. Run /mcp in Claude Code, select figma, and choose Authenticate.
package: Figma-hosted remote MCP server (no local install)
dataNote: Connects to Figma's hosted MCP server with your Figma account; the model can read the design files you grant and write to the canvas.
